import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_weightedsumsq_b()
    return nothing
end

function weightedsumsq_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, w, wb, i_n)
    for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + w[i_seq_x] * u[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
        wb[i_seq_x] = wb[i_seq_x] + u[i_seq_x] ^ 2 * lossb[1]
        ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + (2 * u[i_seq_x]) * (w[i_seq_x] * lossb[1])
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_weightedsumsq_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function weightedsumsq_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, w, wb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_weightedsumsq_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, w)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_weightedsumsq_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, w, wb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_weightedsumsq_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, w)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += w[i_seq_x] * u[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_weightedsumsq_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, w, wb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    wb[i_seq_x] = wb[i_seq_x] + u[i_seq_x] ^ 2 * lossb[1]
    ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + (2 * u[i_seq_x]) * (w[i_seq_x] * lossb[1])
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 3
__base_loss = Float64[0.2971433796404237, -0.18479707952353558, -0.4205285298047127, 0.9322636742498198]
__base_u = Float64[0.11155504171757841, 0.4340634732478062, 0.001974326830772219, 0.8500622118743157]
__base_w = Float64[0.597955406164804, 0.02040245015313651, 1.356612017545688, 0.478284184369826]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-0.707513449611137, 0.342579036868968, -0.4715836545212174, -0.4111624813594786], Float64[0.3904471833483429, -0.644816265004499, 1.182762670857701, -0.4427380374633558]]
__seed_u = [Float64[-0.5093254460181181, -1.3430451535048038, -0.22467612704537648, 0.3664480580549161], Float64[0.5941045901621482, -0.8284701715042405, -0.7277746978730623, -0.16171981533346483]]
__seed_w = [Float64[0.09104184407566196, -0.021672075461711057, -0.15026995921112088, -0.07615635195701591], Float64[-0.6098751023444963, -0.025143894832844772, 0.22754050605760964, -0.08907536638672621]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:2
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  w_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_w); w_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_w[__trial])
  w_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_w)); w_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_w[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_weightedsumsq_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_weightedsumsq_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = weightedsumsq_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, w_val_cpu, w_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = weightedsumsq_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, w_val_gpu, w_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()
  ret_gpu_t = ()
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(w_sh_cpu, Array(w_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(w_val_cpu, Array(w_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
